source_review.notes: Reviewed all seven references for architecture viewpoints, current incident-response guidance, observability, monitoring, reliability practice, operational views, and architecture quality. NIST SP 800-61r3, OpenTelemetry, and Google SRE records returned HTTP 200. The ISO 42010 catalogue returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client; the current 2022 edition was independently confirmed from the official catalogue. The April 2025 NIST revision and current OpenTelemetry material are dated to the retrieval date.
